audit.root_cause: The default game is redalert, which needs the OpenRA binary installed locally (`wargames install --game redalert`) and a Linux/Xvfb game runtime. The VM had neither, so it raised GameNotInstalled. The env code itself loaded fine.
audit.evidence: rollout.log `RuntimeError: GameNotInstalled('OpenRA binary was not found')`; wargames/environments/prime.py:151-152 `def load_environment(game: str = "redalert", ...)`; wargames/cli.py:345 `_default_openra_root` under the cache dir; games/*/backend.py `runs only inside its Linux/Xvfb Docker runtime`
audit.irl_fix: Docs gap: the README never says to run `wargames install --game <g>` or which Docker/Xvfb runtime is needed before `prime eval run`, so add that prerequisite section.
